title: Bill Kurzie's visit to Harlem and later fate
summary: Kurzie in British shorts was mocked in Harlem and returned to Canada; he later married a Syrian woman, and Butler heard he nearly cut a bouncer's arms off with a razor.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: So, now, I left Canada and I come here. And so, Bill come to visit me sometime and the British, you know, the summer suit has short pants, you have your stockings, very neat.
And Bill, so he went up Harlem and -- and a cat got out the window going, 'Hey, black mother-fucker, take them rompers off!'
Bill said, 'Jacques, they hurted me, hurted my feelings. I'm going to visit you and I'm going back to Canada now.'
I said Bill, -- he said, 'I heered what you said Jacques I'm going back to Canada. He's going to make fun of the King's clothes.' I said, well, Bill, and Bill left.

And Bill married a woman, a Syrian woman and she took Bill to Syria and Bill stayed a long, but then he come back. I haven't seen Bill since -- I haven't been in contact, that's my man the last time I was in contact with, but Bill was talking so slow, and then later on, I got news that some bouncer was messing with Bill and forgot, it seemed like Bill cut arms off, liked to and everything else off with his razor, so, then I realized that those people don't talk much, and take them a long time to talk, be on your way out. Something may happen to you. So, that's what I said. So that's what happened.
